projects.title: Shipped Projects & Architecture
projects.description: Deep-dive case studies into enterprise backend platforms, food delivery engines, AI microservices, and management systems.

farrah.title: Farrah (Farra / Wanderr)
farrah.subtitle: Social Travel & Location Discovery Mobile Backend & Admin Dashboard
farrah.description: Farrah is a comprehensive Laravel 12 backend and administrative control system for a travel-focused social mobile app. It supports multi-role mobile authentication, social posting, ghost posts, map check-ins, Mapbox geocoding, stories, realtime chat with reactions, background video transcoding, Firebase push notifications, Fawaterak payment webhooks, paid post promotion campaigns, and admin moderation tools.
farrah.problem: Handling high-volume social interactions, location geocoding, and background video transcoding while maintaining fast API response times.
farrah.solution: Built a modular Laravel API with Redis queue workers for video renditions, Spatie RBAC, Pusher WebSockets for chat, Mapbox geocoding, and Fawaterak webhooks.

baby-track.title: Baby Track
baby-track.subtitle: AI Baby Care Tracking & Cry Classification Platform
baby-track.description: Baby Track combines a Laravel 12 API backend, an admin portal, and a dedicated Python FastAPI Machine Learning microservice for baby cry classification. Parents can track daily feeding, sleep, and diaper routines, record vaccinations, track growth curves, stream sleep sounds, buy devices through an e-commerce shop, and upload cry audio files for AI diagnosis (belly pain, burping, discomfort, hungry, tired).
baby-track.problem: Processing parent audio uploads and predicting cry causes accurately without blocking main API request threads.
baby-track.solution: Architected an asynchronous pipeline sending uploaded audio to a FastAPI microservice, storing predictions with confidence scores and diagnostic feedback.

home-plate.title: Home Plate
home-plate.subtitle: Multi-role Food Ordering & Delivery Management Platform
home-plate.description: Home Plate is a food delivery ecosystem connecting customers, vendors/restaurants, delivery drivers, and platform administrators. Built with Laravel 10, Paymob integration, Firebase FCM, Pusher broadcasting, mPDF tax receipts, and Spatie permission system. Features include idempotent order placement, PIN-based delivery verification, automated driver/vendor digital wallets, coupon validation, and live order chat.
home-plate.problem: Eliminating duplicate order submissions, managing multi-party wallet payouts, and ensuring order delivery security.
home-plate.solution: Implemented idempotent API request headers, automated wallet withdrawal windows, PIN code verification at delivery dropoff, and Paymob payment webhooks.

footeek.title: Footeek E-Commerce Admin
footeek.subtitle: Enterprise E-Commerce & Warehouse Operations Management System
footeek.description: Footeek is a central management platform for modern online stores. Built with Laravel 12, Spatie RBAC, Maatwebsite Excel, Tailwind CSS, Vite, and Alpine.js. It gives administrators full control over product cataloging, variant generation, inventory stock levels, warehouse transfers, courier assignments, return request moderation, delivery zone pricing, and financial reporting.
footeek.problem: Managing massive multi-variant product matrices, stock movements across warehouses, and courier fulfillment assignments.
footeek.solution: Developed bulk variant generation matrices, stocktake ledger tracking, Maatwebsite Excel export/import streams, and area-based shipping rules.

gobite.title: GoBite Restaurant Platform
gobite.subtitle: Restaurant Ordering, Delivery & Loyalty Rewards Engine
gobite.description: GoBite is a complete restaurant management platform combining customer ordering, Socialite login, category/variation browsing, city-area delivery coverage, coupon engines, a loyalty points earning/redemption system, Firebase push notifications, support ticket handling, and operational admin reporting.
gobite.problem: Encouraging customer retention while automating delivery radius pricing and coupon rules.
gobite.solution: Engineered a flexible loyalty point accumulation and redemption engine integrated directly into checkout calculations, alongside automated FCM push token alerts.

movepoint.title: MovePoint Field Operations
movepoint.subtitle: Workforce Administration & Sales Lead Routing Platform
movepoint.description: MovePoint is a workforce management system connecting employees, supervisors, and field representatives. It manages work schedules, monthly target tracking, leave/advance requests, deposit receipts, supervisor team audits, geographic sales lead referrals, salary details, and support tickets through an API-first Laravel backend.
movepoint.problem: Routing field sales leads automatically to representatives based on geographic governorates while processing employee financial requests.
movepoint.solution: Built a location-based lead routing engine, supervisor approval workflows, deposit attachment verification, and Excel spreadsheet export capabilities.

real-estate.title: Real Estate All-Stars
real-estate.subtitle: Real Estate Property Catalog & Awards Voting Platform
real-estate.description: Real Estate All-Stars combines a public real estate portal with an administrative contest management system. Developers showcase projects and units across countries (Egypt, KSA, UAE, Oman, Qatar), while contestants participate in an annual award competition featuring OTP voter verification, vote purchasing, CMS management, judge evaluation, and Excel/PDF reports.
real-estate.problem: Handling high traffic during public voting periods and managing bilingual property portfolios seamlessly.
real-estate.solution: Constructed a bilingual Laravel MVC portal with vote transactions logging, interest lead capturing, video moderation, and PDF/Excel analytical report generation.
